title: Advancements+
description: This projects adds a variety of advancements
body:
# 🏆 Advancements+

Finally, Minecraft advancements have more depth.

Advancements+ is a lightweight datapack that expands vanilla progression by adding a wide variety of new advancements across different aspects of the game. From mining and exploration to farming and combat, every part of Minecraft gets more goals to complete.

##  ✨ Features

### 📜 Dozens of new advancements
Expand your progression with carefully designed achievements across multiple categories.

### ⛏️ Mining & Resources
Track your progress through ores, stones, and natural materials.

### 🌿 Exploration & Survival
Get rewarded for discovering biomes, structures, and survival milestones.

### ⚔️ Combat Challenges
Test your skills with combat-based advancements and progression goals.

### 🌾 Farming & Utility
Encourage interaction with crops, animals, and useful blocks.

### ⚙️ Vanilla-Friendly Design
All advancements are designed to feel like they belong in Minecraft, without changing core gameplay.

### 🧩 Why Advancements+?

Vanilla Minecraft advancements are limited and often end quickly. Advancements+ extends the experience, giving players long-term goals, more structure, and extra motivation to explore every part of the game.

### 📦 Compatibility

• Works in vanilla Minecraft (datapack only)
• No mods required
• Multiplayer compatible
• Safe to add to existing worlds

### 💬 Feedback

Found a bug or have an idea for a new advancement? Feel free to share feedback and suggestions!
